_comment: Case detector rules (PS-18). Chris edits this file; no code change needed. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against extracted text with whitespace collapsed to single spaces. A file is blocked if ANY marker matches, OR if the exhibit count reaches exhibitThreshold AND any teachingPhrase appears. Verify the publisher number formats against real case PDFs in the test set before launch.

markers.label: Harvard copyright line
markers.pattern: president and fellows of harvard college

markers.label: IIM Bangalore
markers.pattern: indian institute of management bangalore|\biim bangalore\b|\bIMB ?\d{3}\b

markers.label: Reproduction prohibited notice
markers.pattern: (no part of this publication|reproduction of this (material|case))[^.]{0,120}(permission|prohibited|without)

chrisCaseTitles._comment: TODO Chris: replace with the exact title strings that appear on your own cases (Bells, MsBA, China, new case). Each is matched as a literal phrase, case-insensitive. Empty strings are ignored.

blockMessage: This looks like a published teaching case, which can't go into an AI tool. Upload your client brief or your own notes instead.
